message.content: {"note_claim": "Iran has experienced a widespread internet blackout since 8 January 2026 that lasted over 100 days and cut most citizens off from the global internet and digital services.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "11 weeks into a near-total online blackout affecting 90 million-plus citizens, which followed a similar 20-day outage during deadly nationwide protests in January.", "reason": "The page confirms a severe, ongoing nationwide blackout that cut most Iranians off from the global internet, but it dates the main blackout to 28 February after a separate 20-day January outage. It does not support a continuous blackout from 8 January lasting over 100 days."}

parsed.note_claim: Iran has experienced a widespread internet blackout since 8 January 2026 that lasted over 100 days and cut most citizens off from the global internet and digital services.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: 11 weeks into a near-total online blackout affecting 90 million-plus citizens, which followed a similar 20-day outage during deadly nationwide protests in January.
parsed.reason: The page confirms a severe, ongoing nationwide blackout that cut most Iranians off from the global internet, but it dates the main blackout to 28 February after a separate 20-day January outage. It does not support a continuous blackout from 8 January lasting over 100 days.
